expectations.text: SAVE"NAME" (device 1 is the default for tape, optionally SAVE"NAME",1)
expectations.evidence: Shows SAVE "MYPROG" and states device 1 is default — no device number needed; correct.

expectations.text: LOAD"NAME" searches forward for that named program; LOAD with no name loads the next program
expectations.evidence: "LOAD "MYPROG" scans forward from current tape position" and "Bare LOAD (no name) = loads next program"; both correct.

expectations.text: Explains tape is sequential with no random-access directory
expectations.evidence: "scans forward from current tape position, checks each header" and "Tape only moves forward, so rewind first" — conveys sequential, no index/directory.

expectations.text: Mentions practical ways to find a program (tape counter / forward search / header messages)
expectations.evidence: Covers all three: tape counter (note Datasette counter number), forward search (LOAD scans forward), header messages (FOUND <name>).
